preconditions.description: Number of test cases is between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 100 for n in ns)
preconditions.description: Length of each sequence is between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= ai <= 10**9 for ai in a)
preconditions.description: Each element in the sequence is between 0 and 10^9.

postconditions.description: The number of output values matches the number of test cases.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(o, int) for o in output)
postconditions.description: Each output value is an integer.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= o <= max(a) for o in output)
postconditions.description: Each output value is between 0 and the maximum value in the corresponding sequence.
